name: Xiao Yang
source:
Class monitor and role model for the others. Student of the Uteme-Lovond Academy
Also a member of the security committee. Despite this, Xiao sometimes gets tired of studying and sometimes wants to relax.
Often teased by Margarita.
According to the Longevity system, Xiao is a High-ranking mtsyr.

[spoiler]In fact, he never existed outside of Mtsyri's World. He is a figment of the real Xiaomin's imagination and also a partial embodiment of her personality.[/spoiler]
